connectorUiConfig.title: AbuseIPDB Blacklist (using Sentinel Connector Builder Agent)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The AbuseIPDB connector ingests blacklisted IP address data from the AbuseIPDB threat intelligence platform into Microsoft Sentinel. Data includes IP addresses, abuse confidence scores, country codes, and last reported timestamps.

Supports API Key authentication.

For more information, visit [AbuseIPDB API Docs](https://docs.abuseipdb.com/#blacklist-endpoint).

graphQueries.baseQuery: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: AbuseIPDB API Key
customs.description: An AbuseIPDB API Key is required. [See documentation](https://docs.abuseipdb.com/#blacklist-endpoint)

sampleQueries.description: All blacklisted IPs from the last 24 hours
Top 10 countries by blacklisted IP count
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Count = count() by CountryCode | top 10 by Count

{{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 90 | project TimeGenerated, IpAddress, AbuseConfidenceScore, CountryCode, LastReportedAt | order by AbuseConfidenceScore desc

sampleQueries.description: Recently reported IPs sorted by last report time
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project IpAddress, AbuseConfidenceScore, CountryCode, LastReportedAt | order by LastReportedAt desc | take 50

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Obtain your AbuseIPDB API Key
instructionSteps.description: Log in to your [AbuseIPDB](https://www.abuseipdb.com/) account and navigate to **User Account > API**. Copy your API key.

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Enter credentials and connect
instructionSteps.description: Provide your AbuseIPDB API key below to start ingesting blacklist data.
